# `discarded-write-count`

<!-- rule-docs:header (generated by `zig build rule-docs`) -->
Tier: correctness · Profile: none · Default: warning · Fixes: none · Options: none

Reports an explicitly discarded return value from a writer's `write` method.
<!-- /rule-docs:header -->

## Why it matters

`write` may consume only part of its input. Discarding the count can silently
truncate output even when the call itself succeeds.

## When it fires

Use `writeAll` when all bytes must be written. Keep `write` when partial
progress is intentional and its returned count is handled.

<!-- rule-docs:footer (generated by `zig build rule-docs`) -->
## Example

```zig
fn send(writer: anytype, bytes: []const u8) !void {
    _ = try writer.write(bytes);
}
```
